initial_eminence.title: Salazar sneaks into Diagon Alley
initial_eminence.description: Through a combination of concealment charms, arithmancy, and perception, Slytherin discerns how to enter Diagon Alley and sneaks inside. Salazar's mother did not want him to interact with wizarding folk. However, he sneaks into Diagon Alley anyway. Gryffindor notices him do this and immediately recognizes his talents. The magical commuinity welcomes Salazar, but he remains wary of others.

initial_eminence.title: Godric and Salazar trade knowledge
initial_eminence.description:
Against his mother's wishes, Salazar spends the majority of the summer of 986 studying with Godric. They aren't exactly friends, but they teach one another what they know. Salazar, having now invented many spells and having harnessed his parseltongue and arithmancy skills, had much to teach Gryffindor about the magical world. Godric had a more foundational grasp of concepts that Salazar had not yet encountered.

Godric spent the summer in London exclusively to be close to Salazar for the purposes of their mutual study.

initial_eminence.title: Godric and Salazar study together
initial_eminence.description:
Godric and Slytherin spend another summer studying together, inventing spells and documenting magical concepts. They aren't exactly friends, they just recognize the value the other brings. Godric remains quite skeptical of slytherin's moral compass and his intentions.

Godric spends an entire summer living in London to study with Salazar

initial_eminence.title: Godric and Salazar study together
initial_eminence.description: Throughout the entire year, Godric and Salazar regularly study together, continuing to harness their skills.

initial_eminence.title: Salazar and Godric continue their study
Godric and Salazar study intensely
initial_eminence.description: Throughout the first part of the year, Godric and Salazar study nearly daily together and rapidly improve their skills.

initial_eminence.title: Godric recruits Ravenclaw
initial_eminence.description: Rowena and Godric were friends from Wessex for years. Godric always respected Rowena and was excited to ask her to join the mission to found Hogwarts.

initial_eminence.title: Rowena, Godric and Salazar travel together
initial_eminence.description: The three future founders begin to travel the British Isles together seeking a potential site for their school. The had no intention of bringing on another founder. However, they were charmed and impressed by Helga Hufflepuff when they met her in the Orkneys. She suggested the area that eventually became the home of Hogwarts. During their time traveling together, they continued to share their mutually beneficial skillsets with one another.

initial_eminence.title: Discovers Diagon Alley
initial_eminence.description: Through felt-sense, he develops an ability to detect traces of magic. This leads him to explore London eventually independently discovering Diagon Alley.

people.narrative:
Emeric the Evil is born in Saxony to wealthy and loving muggle parents. They realize his magical gift and realize he needs support in developing it. They learn of Hogwarts and arrange to ensure he can attend the school. 

Slytherin hated him because of his muggleborn status. So after a minor incident with other students, Slytherin amplified evidence to paint Emeric as dangerous and untrustworthy. Slytherin assured he would be expelled. Emeric was furious at Slytherin for his sabotage of his future, bitter at the other staff for failing to protect him, and became angry at all magical folk, launching his mission to seek power, his drive to kill wizards, and his search for the elder wand.

organizations.notes:
Hogwarts was founded in part as a response to regular viking invasions in the mid to late 10th century. Wizarding magic tended to be too fragmented and imprecise to reliably be used to defend towns from raids. The founders saw the need to educate the public in magical prowess so that more mages were available to defend against raids. For a time, this worked. Vikings were relatively stymied. 

This too is why Slytherin was included as a founder. His skill was seen as valuable even if his morals questionable. 

Emerick the Evil learned from Slytherin and eventually turned on the wizarding population killing many important figures and significantly weakening wizarding defenses. Armand Malfoy and William the Conquerer then capitalized on the moment to invade in 1066.

Helga contributed to many functional elements of the castle, created numerous efficencies, and built the kitchens.
